claim_scope: set-theoretic candidate-surface semantics only; not FRANK/Qwen performance evidence
question: Can an external workspace that is only a pure filter over an internal candidate surface recover relevant candidates absent from that surface?

augmentation_control.candidate_relation: We may contain elements outside Wi

proof_note: If We subset_of Wi, then (We intersect R) subset_of (Wi intersect R), therefore recall(We) <= recall(Wi). Enumeration is an executable implementation check of this invariant.
architecture_implication: A nested model/internal-to-system GWT bridge must type its candidate-surface relation as FILTER|AUGMENT|RECONSTRUCT|UNKNOWN. FILTER can improve selectivity/precision but cannot rescue absent relevant candidates without an augmentation/re-query/reconstruction path.
negative_boundary: This result does not show that AUGMENT is beneficial in FRANK, that a Qwen internal workspace exists, or that any workspace mechanism is emergent/conscious.
